item.description: Winter internship at CUPP, CEPT University, working on statutory planning, land policy, urban governance, policy analysis and capacity-building for government agencies.
item.author: Center for Urban Planning and Policy (CUPP), CEPT Research and Development Foundation (Ahmedabad)

item.title: MoEFCC Internship Scheme 2027
item.description: MoEFCC Internship Scheme 2027: students gain practical exposure to government functioning, environmental regulation, developmental policies and research activities. Duration up to 3 months, starting 1 February 2027.
item.author: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) (New Delhi)

item.title: Climate & Biodiversity Analyst Intern
item.description: 6-month internship in Candriam's Climate Transition & Impact Investing team, starting January-February 2027. Integrate environmental considerations into investment decisions.
item.author: Candriam (Remote (Global))

item.title: Wildlife Enthusiasts Course
item.description: This course offers a structured learning pathway for individuals keen to understand Indian wildlife and conservation practices. Participants engage with faculty from the Wildlife Institute of India to explore diverse ecosystems and species management strategies. The program is designed to provide foundational knowledge for those looking to pursue a professional career in wildlife research or environmental education within the country.
item.author: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) (Remote (India))

item.title: Research Intern - Sustainable Food Systems
item.description: The Council on Energy, Environment and Water is seeking a research intern to support its sustainable food systems programme. You will work with senior researchers to analyse agricultural policy, food security metrics, and climate-resilient farming practices in the Indian context. This role offers exposure to high-impact policy research and data-driven analysis within a leading climate think-tank.
item.author: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW) (Remote (India))
